01 / Experience

Where the work happens

PL/SQL Developer

EFU Life Assurance Ltd.
2023 — Present · Karachi
insurance domain

Working across multiple business-critical applications and modules, I own database logic for policy, customer, payment, commission and renewal processes. I take requirements from business users, turn them into PL/SQL solutions, carry them through UAT and production deployment, and support them afterwards.

Policy issuance automation

Replaced a manual ERP-based process with a web-portal workflow: users upload an Excel file and policies are validated, processed and issued automatically across multiple insurance modules.

Payment processing engine

Automated payment generation for the Finance department, moving and integrating data across multiple databases and environments while cutting manual intervention.

Business-rule validation layer

Comprehensive validations for policy issuance that guarantee data accuracy, enforce compliance with business rules and block invalid transactions before they land.

Full responsibility breakdown
  • Developed and enhanced Oracle PL/SQL procedures, functions, packages, triggers and database objects supporting core business processes.
  • Built backend logic for Excel-based policy uploads: data processing, business-rule validation, error handling and integration with multiple insurance system modules.
  • Analyzed and optimized complex SQL queries and PL/SQL code to improve application performance and reduce processing time.
  • Troubleshot production and development issues across SQL, PL/SQL procedures, database data and application workflows.
  • Performed data analysis and reconciliation across systems to identify discrepancies and ensure consistency.
  • Worked on database integration and inter-system communication between Oracle-based applications.
  • Participated in UAT, production deployments, issue resolution and post-deployment support for business-critical applications.
  • Collaborated with developers, business analysts, finance teams and other stakeholders to deliver solutions aligned with business requirements.
  • Kept code quality, performance, data integrity, scalability and maintainability at the centre of every database solution.
